  - text: CLASS 10 · MENSURATION
  - heading "Frustum of a Cone" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Explore a cone cut by a plane parallel to the base. Adjust dimensions, see the 3D frustum and its net, and verify formulas.
  - navigation:
    - button "3D VIEW"
    - button "UNFOLDED NET"
  - button "Reset lab":
    - img
    - text: Reset lab
  - main:
    - heading "DIMENSIONS" [level=2]
    - text: R (base radius) 6
    - slider "R (base radius)": "6"
    - text: 1 10 r (top radius) 3
    - slider "r (top radius)": "3"
    - text: 0.5 5.5 h (vertical height) 8
    - slider "h (vertical height)": "8"
    - text: 1 15
    - complementary:
      - heading "DERIVED VALUES" [level=2]
      - strong: l = √(h² + (R − r)²)
      - paragraph: l = √(8² + (6 − 3)²) ≈ 8.54
    - heading "3D EXPLORER" [level=2]
    - application "Interactive three-dimensional frustum; drag to rotate and scroll to zoom":
      - paragraph: Interactive three-dimensional frustum; drag to rotate and scroll to zoom
    - button "Animate":
      - img
      - text: Animate
    - slider "Animation speed": "0.5"
    - text: View
    - button "perspective view":
      - img
    - button "front view":
      - img
    - button "top view":
      - img
    - button "side view":
      - img
    - heading "NET (UNFOLDED LATERAL SURFACE)" [level=2]
    - text: Unfold
    - checkbox "Unfold" [checked]
    - img "Annular sector net of the frustum": 2πR 2πr θ
    - complementary:
      - strong: θ = 2π(R − r) / l = 2.21 rad
      - paragraph: θ ≈ 126.4°
      - text: Outer radius 17.09, inner radius 8.54
  - heading "RESULTS" [level=2]
  - article:
    - text: VOLUME
    - strong: V = πh(R² + Rr + r²) / 3
    - paragraph: ≈ 527.79 cubic units
  - article:
    - text: CURVED SURFACE AREA (LATERAL)
    - strong: CSA = π(R + r)l
    - paragraph: ≈ 241.58 square units
  - article:
    - text: TOTAL SURFACE AREA (INCLUDING BASES)
    - strong: TSA = CSA + πR² + πr²
    - paragraph: ≈ 382.95 square units
  - complementary:
    - text: IMPORTANT WARNING
    - paragraph: Do NOT use h in place of l for curved surface area.
    - strong: Use l = √(h² + (R − r)²).
  - img
  - text: All values update live as you move the sliders. Formulas use exact π and precise calculations.
